name: easyslides
description: EasySlides creates editable academic PPTX decks and distills source PowerPoint files into content-free semantic templates, components, and symbols with fail-closed visual QA.

interface.shortDescription: Create, distill, edit, and review editable PPTX files.
interface.longDescription: EasySlides turns papers, reports, Markdown, web pages, and existing PowerPoint files into structured editable presentations. Its distillation route separates source evidence from content-free semantic layout families, reusable components, and symbols, then requires native PowerPoint and visual QA before production promotion.
defaultPrompt: 使用 EasySlides 把这个 PPTX 蒸馏为无内容的语义模板、组件和符号资产。
Use EasySlides to create an editable academic PPTX from my source materials.
Use EasySlides to review this presentation and fix blocking visual issues.
